gate_policy: Every applicable gate must pass; preserve original failures. Any changed scope, model, numerical bounds or qualified engine requires a distinct prospective task.

gates.title: Package identity
gates.acceptance: Use an isolated tracked-source checkout plus only proposed/ overlays. Verify exact qualified loader/Wasm hashes, generated twelve-model catalogue and all eleven prior definition hashes. Retain ordinary GIS failure. Normal stale-catalogue guard must pass.

gates.title: Packaged disclosures
gates.acceptance: MC is draft, source review pending and unassigned. Primary source hyperlinks work in schema and webpage; dossier and numerical evidence retain bounded scope, limitations and no experimental-validation claim. Existing authors and source links remain.

gates.title: Saved request compatibility
gates.acceptance: Execute the fourteen frozen current-producer MC requests and twelve pre-existing compatibility requests through the packaged worker. Compare full responses to qualified same-backend observations excluding elapsed time only and the already-declared compatibility catalogue identity. Preserve every intended failure.

gates.title: Project path and default
gates.acceptance: Serve under /constitutive-atlas/. Observe actual fetched engine/catalogue/module hashes. Select MC and run unchanged drained default: 100 increments, 101 points, six persistent stress states, effective-stress labels and correct pore-pressure semantics. No missing assets or console errors.

gates.title: Fourteen full-state replays
gates.acceptance: Construct versioned 0.2 import documents from the archived qualified Wasm journal using production document helpers. Record provenance and hashes before browser execution. Import each of fourteen exact requests into a fresh worker; compare all 834 points and all persistent state values with saved observations using original frozen numerical bounds. No source-ideal replacement responses.

gates.title: Round trip and reset
gates.acceptance: Download actual browser JSON, reload, import and replay one cyclic and one monotonic request. Verify six-state history, controls/settings and identity. Verify CSV remains an observation export. Switch model and reset; no stale MC state, settings, overlays or curves.

gates.title: Rejection and recovery
gates.acceptance: Show visible rejection for c=0 and an inadmissible initial stress, then restore valid values and reproduce the reference. Reject duplicate keys, overflow and stale catalogue imports before material execution. Retain rejection evidence and successful recovery separately.

gates.title: Prior-model and experiment semantics
gates.acceptance: Check total-stress Tresca guard, named small GIS success and ordinary GIS failure without changing defaults. Check overlay toggle, rights and attribution; MC has no void-ratio state, density/preparation matching or calibration claim. If the generic matching label implies unavailable density matching, record a delivery blocker and make any generic correction a separately scoped change.

gates.title: Close and review
gates.acceptance: Save observations, downloaded exports, screenshots, console/network evidence and pass/fail report bound to package hashes. Close owned server/browser resources. Install the exact proposed delta only after all gates pass; scientific status stays draft/pending. No push or deployment.
